application_fee.details: The CWC application fee is Rs. 850 plus intimation charges of Rs. 500 (Rs. 1,350 in total) for UR, EWS and OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from the application fee but must pay intimation charges of Rs. 500. The amount is inclusive of GST, and the payment gateway charges are borne by the candidate. | The fee is non-refundable and is paid through the online payment gateway only. Payment by DD, cheque or postal order is not accepted. Payment can be made by debit card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), credit card, internet banking, UPI, IMPS, cash cards or mobile wallets. A candidate applying for more than one post must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated. If no e-receipt is generated, the payment has failed, and the candidate should log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

age_limit.details: The CWC age limit is a maximum of 28 years as on 15.11.2026 for all the posts. Candidates should not have been born earlier than 16.11.1998 and later than 15.11.2008, both days inclusive. The maximum age in Table-A is applicable to UR candidates, and the following relaxation is given on top of it. | With cumulative age relaxation, the maximum age limit cannot exceed 55 years as on 15.11.2026. For Ex-Servicemen (post codes 07 and 08), the period of actual military service is deducted from the actual age, and the resultant age should not exceed the maximum age limit by more than 3 years (8 years for SC/ST and 6 years for OBC candidates). The relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with any one of the other categories listed above, except SC/ST/OBC themselves. Departmental candidates (regular CWC employees) get age relaxation only if they have at least 5 years of service left on the last date of receipt of applications. Age concession is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age or qualifying-marks relaxation.

how_to_apply: Candidates can apply online only from 17.10.2026 to 15.11.2026. No other mode of application is accepted. A candidate can apply for one or more posts according to the qualification and eligibility, but must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. Not more than one application should be submitted for a particular post.
Keep ready a scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and a hand-written declaration, a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and the details for online payment.
Go to www.cewacor.nic.in, click the link "Career @CWC (Direct Recruitment)-2026" and then "Click here to apply online for Advertisement No. 2026/01".
Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and e-mail ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password are generated and also sent by e-mail and SMS.

Fill in the application form. The "Save and Next" option can be used to save the data and verify it. The name of the candidate and the father/husband must be spelt as in the Class 10 certificate/mark sheet.
Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration, and capture the live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
Preview the form, click "Complete Registration" after verifying, then use the "Payment" tab to pay the fee and click "Submit".
Take a printout of the application form and the e-receipt. Do not send them to CWC.

The text of the declaration is: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Visually impaired candidates or others who cannot write may get the text typed and put their left thumb impression below it. The online application is not registered unless the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration are uploaded as specified.
